column1: # Manual channel-id aliases.
# When automatic matching (callsign / normalized-name / token-set) can't
# pin upstream EPG data to one of your M3U channels, add a line here:
#   <m3u_effective_id><TAB><upstream_channel_id>
# Example: if your M3U has a channel with tvg-id `BBC.One.Local.uk` and the
# upstream iptv-org/epg source emits programmes against id `bbc1.uk@LDN`,
# the line below routes upstream data to your channel:
#   BBC.One.Local.uk
# Notes:
#   * One alias per line. Comments start with '#'.
#   * The fields are TAB-separated (single tab character).
#   * Upstream id is matched against the channel-id of any provider /
#     iptv-org/epg source.
#   * Aliases are applied during the backfill pass — they take priority
#     over automatic callsign / name-based matching, so use sparingly to
#     fix hard-to-pin cases (Arabic-script channels, region splits, etc.).
#   * Append-only: order doesn't matter.
# Nat Geo Abu Dhabi (2026-06): the provider M3U misspells the name
# ('Natioanl Geo') so no name tier can match, and the generic 'Abu Dhabi'
# (Abu Dhabi TV) feed used to token-match it instead — wrong schedule in
# English, invisible to every guard. Pin to epgshare AE1's real feed
# (verified content: Air Crash Investigation, Ice Road Rescue, ...).
# Covers both the 4K and HD variants (they share this tvg-id).
NationalGeographicAbuDhabi.ae
# 2026-06 audit pins — each of these shipped a different channel's feed:
# GO: SYFY carried Spanish TVE 'Noticias 24H' news; pin the real Syfy
# (epgshare US2, verified English movie titles).
GO: SYFY
# UK Crime+Investigation carried an Italian CI feed ('GURU - La storia
# di Matteo Cambi') under its own direct id, and the provider stamped a
# FRENCH channel's id (Planète+ Justice) on the 4K variant. Pin both to
# the real UK feed (epgshare UK1, verified English true-crime titles).
CrimeInvestigation.uk
PlaneteJustice.fr
# 'CW PIX 11' is WPIX New York but was showing KSTW Seattle's schedule
# (token match on {CW, 11}); pin the real WPIX (epgshare US_LOCALS1).
US: CW PIX 11 HD
